notes.title: 0.3.01_RC
notes.content:
With this update I am moving the version from Beta to Release Candidate ... soooo close!!!
Direct bug reports or any polish ideas to the usual inbox.

0.3.01_RC
	+ Changed Gnome achievement trigger to fire when actually holding the Gnome.
	+ Changed Gnome to allow storage in Large pack slot
	+ Changed VOs on VooDooDoll
	+ Added thicker colliders to vial rack interior.
	+ Added SFX for face menu clicks
	+ Added SFX when gaining Achievements

notes.title: 0.2.08_beta
notes.content:
0.2.08_beta
	[b]To go along with some more asset optimizations... are the following updates.[/b]
	+ Fixed inedible mushrooms vanishing
	+ Fixed water splash fx not turning off when going down elevator
	+ Fixed cook pot not being grabbable anymore
	+ Fixed WAM machine to no longer allow stepping up onto it when leaning over it
	+ Added SFX to DropBridge busting boards
	+ Changed some WAM machine meshes
	+ Changed the CCTV monitors in Gramps Room to only display video when player is near AND looking towards the screen.
	+ Changed the Pirate Scope to activate when held, instead of proximity
